data.name: IX.br (PTT.br) São Paulo
data.notes:
This is the Peering information for the IX.br (PTT.br) Route Servers.

There are two route servers per IXP for redundancy purposes in Sao Paulo

For IX.br (PTT.br) Sao Paulo we recommend a maximum-prefixes setting 480K for IPv4 and 290K for IPv6

Communities added by the route server  to identify the location where the prefix was received:
* 16-bit ASN: 26162:65011
* 32-bit ASN: RT:26162:65011 or RO:26162:65011


IX.br Communities BGP Policy

http://docs.ix.br/doc/politica-de-tratamento-de-communities-no-ix-br-v4_3-english.pdf


Communities BGP Table

data.name: KCIX
data.notes:
### How to participate?
Please visit http://kcix.net and fill out the small form on the front page or email peering@kcix.net to connect. 

Now offering 100G/40G ports in 1102 Grand and 1530 Swift.

### Max Prefix Settings
Recommended limits to allow for future growth  
IPv4: 200000  
IPv6: 100000  

### Route Server Communities:
 0:$peerasn to exclude your routes to $peerasn
40542:$peerasn to include your routes to $peerasn
0:40542 to exclude your routes from all peers

### Official KCIX Extensions:
St. Louis, Missouri via [STLIX.net](http://stlix.net)  
[https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/2585](https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/2585)

Houston, Texas via [HOUIX.net](http://houix.net)  
[https://peeringdb.com/ix/2835](https://peeringdb.com/ix/2835)

Springfield, Missouri via [SpringIX.net](http://springix.net)  
[https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/3195](https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/3195)

Minneapolis, Minnesota via [MNVoIP.com](http://mnvoip.com)  
[https://www.peeringdb.com/net/4044](https://www.peeringdb.com/net/4044)

### Mailing List:
Please email info@kcix.net if you wish to be subscribed to the KCIX members mailing list.

data.name: InterLAN-IX
data.notes:
**InterLAN-IX** is a neutral Internet Exchange platform focused on serving the Romanian internet ecosystem. Operated by the Interlan Association, it facilitates efficient interconnection between networks across major cities in Romania. The platform supports openness, collaboration, and local traffic exchange, with an emphasis on community-driven development and operational transparency.


*For peering with the InterLAN-IX route servers, please see [InterLAN-IX Route Servers](https://www.peeringdb.com/net/11965).*

data.name: SONIX Stockholm
data.notes:
The Open Internet Exchange, Powered by You.

SONIX strives to be an IXP built on as much open technologies and projects as possible.

We offer free 400G, 200G, 100G, 40G, 25G or 10G ports for anyone who wants to join.

Founded by a non-profit, SONIX will live as a community driven IXP. If you have an idea where SONIX can help out - reach out!

data.name: ERA-IX Amsterdam
data.notes:
A new era of peering!

The future of peering on internet exchanges is under pressure, due to ever-growing costs, high number of failures, and a "too corporate" culture. In mid-2022 two internet pioneers decided to bring a better and more cost-effective alternative, and we never looked back.

### Our mission
It is our mission to redefine peering, by offering an innovative and cost-effective IXP ecosystem. The current state of peering is not-so-great and in a headlock by large corporate IXP-operators.

### Our way
We are truly neutral, fully privately owned and funded. Powered by a new generation of internet pioneers, our goal is to offer transparent and enterprise-ready connectivity services with a human touch.

### About us
We are the new-generation connectivity partner, fully privately owned and funded. We have built a next-generation connectivity fabric across major datacenters in Amsterdam and Frankfurt. [Read more](https://www.eranium.io/about) about our initiative.

### Latest news
Connect now with 400G! Read more about it on our [blog here](https://www.eranium.io/blog/114/the-new-fabric-and-400g).

[RS Looking Glass](https://era-ix.com/lookingglass)
